facts.fact: Decree D/2025/053 of 14 April 2025 provides that civil status officers reach the system through secure authentication and may register civil status events on paper and on electronic support, and that the means of authentication are issued and renewed by the body in charge of civil status and identification.

systems.tiers: the number is instituted for every Guinean on the issue of the birth act; the population register is fed by the national civil status register, and the communal register of persons is kept up to date by the communal civil status register

note: Three decrees of 14 April 2025, an excerpt that stops at Article 9 of the third. They are legal provisions and state no office count and nothing on what is in use: the third decree allows registration on paper or electronically without saying which is done, so no fact on events, how the record is made or offices.
